title: Hedgehog holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='balloonGrad' cx='0.35' cy='0.3' r='0.75'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff8fa3'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#e83e5c'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#c1203f'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d='M66 40 Q62 52 58 62' stroke='#a8e6ff' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='26' rx='13' ry='15' fill='url(#balloonGrad)'/>
  <ellipse cx='63.5' cy='20' rx='3.4' ry='4.6' fill='#ffd0d9' opacity='0.85'/>
  <polygon points='66,40 70,40 68,44' fill='#c1203f'/>
  <!-- hedgehog body -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='72' rx='24' ry='17' fill='#c98a52'/>
  <!-- spiny back -->
  <path d='M20 70 Q18 52 30 44 Q40 38 52 42 Q62 46 64 58 Q66 66 62 72 Q52 78 42 78 Q28 78 20 70 Z' fill='#8a5a2e'/>
  <!-- spine highlights -->
  <g stroke='#a8703c' stroke-width='2.6' stroke-linecap='round'>
    <line x1='26' y1='62' x2='22' y2='54'/>
    <line x1='32' y1='54' x2='29' y2='45'/>
    <line x1='40' y1='50' x2='39' y2='41'/>
    <line x1='48' y1='50' x2='50' y2='42'/>
    <line x1='56' y1='54' x2='59' y2='47'/>
    <line x1='61' y1='61' x2='65' y2='55'/>
  </g>
  <!-- face -->
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='74' rx='13' ry='11' fill='#f2c99b'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='25' cy='77' rx='6' ry='4.5' fill='#f7dcbb'/>
  <circle cx='21.5' cy='76' r='2.4' fill='#4a2e1e'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='70' r='2.7' fill='#3a2415'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='69' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- ear -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='64' r='3.6' fill='#f2c99b'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='64' r='1.8' fill='#e0a877'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='89' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#e0a877'/>
  <ellipse cx='47' cy='89' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#e0a877'/>
  <!-- arm reaching to string -->
  <path d='M52 72 Q56 68 58 63' stroke='#c98a52' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='62' r='3.4' fill='#f2c99b'/>
</svg>
